name: Agent Plugins
summary: Vendor-neutral standard (v1.0.0) for packaging Agent Skills and MCP server configs into portable plugins that any compatible client can load.
description: A plugin is a directory with a required `plugin.json` manifest, optional `skills/` (Agent Skills format) and `mcp.json` (stdio, Streamable HTTP or legacy HTTP+SSE servers), plus reverse-domain namespaces for client-specific extensions. Initial Technical Steering Committee includes maintainers from Amazon, Cursor, Microsoft, OpenAI and Vercel.
